t: The Forge Steel Mixed Multi-Bit Screwdriver Set provides essential tools for various fastening tasks. This versatile screwdriver kit includes a stubby screwdriver and a ratchet screwdriver, both featuring durable chrome vanadium steel blades. It is ideal for trade professionals and DIYers tackling installations or repairs in confined areas, such as electrical boxes or plumbing fixtures. The compact, ultra-short handle of the stubby driver ensures excellent access to tight spaces, while the ergonomic handles offer a comfortable grip for prolonged use. Magnetised tips securely grip screws during positioning and removal, enhancing efficiency on site. The stubby screwdriver includes 7 interchangeable bits (PH, PZ and SL), while the ratchet screwdriver includes 14 interchangeable bits (PH, PZ, SL and TX), all conveniently stored within the handles.
b: Contents: stubby screwdriver with 7 x 40mm bits (PH1, PH2, PZ1, PZ2, SL3, SL4 and SL5) and ratchet screwdriver with 14 x bits (PZ0, PZ1, PZ2, PH0, PH1, PH2, PH2, SL3, SL4, SL5, SL6, T10, T15 and T20).
